whoSpeaks: A named person, in first person
exposureNote: Reading is invisible, but liking, commenting or saving is visible to his own followers. The cost sits on the response, not on the content.
lengthBudget: First line does the work; the rest is read only by people who already decided to keep reading
replyExpected: No. A comment is a public act and should never be the only route onward.

avoidHere.why: Jangan mengubah komentar, reaksi, atau share menjadi cara untuk mengungkap kondisi pribadi pembaca. Hindari judul yang menyerupai diagnosis (“5 tanda kamu sebenarnya depresi”) dan jangan mengandalkan feed sebagai satu-satunya jalur informasi keselamatan atau bantuan darurat.

evidenceNote: The sequencing affordance of carousels is described in the platform section of the voice strategy, not measured. Indonesian platform behaviour in this corpus is assertion rather than data.
channelRule: Buat pesan utama dapat dipahami tanpa meminta pembaca membuka pengalaman pribadi. Gunakan slide awal untuk memberi alasan yang jelas untuk terus membaca—misalnya situasi yang mudah dikenali, pertanyaan yang relevan, temuan, atau pernyataan utama. Jika membahas pengalaman personal, jelaskan siapa penuturnya dan jangan menampilkan cerita fiktif sebagai kesaksian nyata.

exposureNote: Nobody sees him open it, read it or ignore it. This is the lowest-exposure channel Menungsa has.
lengthBudget: Long enough to document a full pathway; the reader chose to be here
replyExpected: Optional, and private if it happens

avoidHere.why: Jangan menyembunyikan informasi penting di bagian akhir email, membuat subjek lebih mendesak daripada isi sebenarnya, atau menganggap setiap email harus meminta tindakan. Jika tidak ada respons yang diperlukan, katakan dengan jelas.

evidenceNote: Email appears nowhere in the corpus. Its settings are inherited from the long-form findings on the grounds that both are chosen, private and permit a documented pathway. Treat as a starting hypothesis.
channelRule: Gunakan ruang yang lebih panjang untuk memberi konteks, rincian, dan langkah yang diperlukan pembaca. Untuk email program atau layanan, letakkan informasi penting—tujuan pesan, waktu, biaya, cara bergabung, perubahan jadwal, atau tindakan yang diminta—secara jelas dan mudah dipindai.

exposureNote: The highest-exposure channel in ordinary use. Replying in a group is visible to everyone in it, and read receipts make even silence legible. Membership itself may disclose something he has not chosen to disclose.
lengthBudget: Short enough to read without expanding the message
replyExpected: No, and the message should say so

avoidHere.why: Di grup, jangan meminta anggota mengungkap kondisi pribadi atau menunjukkan minat pada layanan kesehatan mental secara publik jika tidak diperlukan. Hindari “ketik HADIR”, polling, atau reaction jika responsnya dapat membuka informasi pribadi.
Di grup, jangan meminta anggota mengungkap kondisi pribadi atau menunjukkan minat pada layanan kesehatan mental secara publik jika tidak diperlukan.

evidenceNote: WhatsApp is absent from the corpus entirely. The exposure reasoning is derived from the response-cost mechanism rather than from any platform study, and the mechanism itself has no direct test.
channelRule: Tulis singkat dan letakkan informasi yang paling dibutuhkan di awal. Bedakan pesan siaran yang diterima secara privat dari grup yang responsnya terlihat oleh anggota lain. Untuk topik personal, pendaftaran, atau pertanyaan kesehatan mental, arahkan respons ke jalur privat.

whoSpeaks: A named human, never an unattributed account
exposureNote: Invisible to everyone else. This is why it carries the contexts that cannot survive an audience.
lengthBudget: Short turns; this is a conversation, not a broadcast
replyExpected: Yes, and the absence of one must carry no penalty

avoidHere.why: Jangan memperlakukan DM sebagai diagnosis, konseling, atau layanan krisis jika Menungsa tidak menyediakan fungsi tersebut. Jangan meminta seluruh cerita sebagai syarat mendapat informasi atau berjanji “kami selalu ada” jika respons tidak dipantau terus-menerus. Auto-reply boleh digunakan untuk menjelaskan jam pemantauan dan batas respons secara jujur.

evidenceNote: No direct-message evidence exists in the corpus. The highest-risk cell in the whole matrix is crisis content here, and the corpus is explicit that gender-tailored male suicide-prevention interventions have not demonstrated clear effects in randomised evidence.
channelRule: Tanggapi pertanyaan yang diajukan terlebih dahulu tanpa meminta cerita pribadi yang tidak diperlukan. Jelaskan siapa atau apa yang membalas jika itu membantu memahami batas percakapan, lalu berikan satu langkah paling relevan. Gunakan informasi layanan yang sudah diverifikasi; jika muncul risiko keselamatan, beralih ke protokol krisis.

whoSpeaks: The organisation, with named authors where a person is speaking
exposureNote: Reading is private and leaves no trace anyone else can see.
lengthBudget: Complete. This is the channel that carries the whole pathway.

avoidHere.why: Jangan menggunakan panjang tulisan untuk membuat argumen terdengar lebih pasti daripada bukti yang tersedia. Hindari generalisasi luas dari satu pengalaman, satu penelitian, atau satu kelompok pembaca, serta penutup yang memaksakan satu pelajaran moral dari persoalan kompleks.

evidenceNote: The role of long-form as the home of authority and documented access is stated in the voice strategy as a design decision, not as a measured result.
channelRule: Gunakan ruang yang lebih panjang untuk menjelaskan konteks, hubungan antaride, bukti, dan ketidakpastian yang tidak cukup ditampung dalam format singkat. Bedakan dengan jelas antara data, interpretasi Menungsa, pengalaman personal, dan usulan atau refleksi penulis.

whoSpeaks: A named individual, in whatever register that person actually speaks
exposureNote: Watching is invisible; following, commenting or sharing is not.
lengthBudget: The first three seconds decide everything else

avoidHere.why: Crisis content should not be delivered through a format optimised for retention and interruption.

evidenceNote: Licensing is maximally visible in spoken video, which follows from the messenger-credibility mechanism, but no study in the corpus tests video format directly.
channelRule: The first three seconds are a situation, not a hook question. A question the viewer must answer to keep watching is itself an exposure cost.

whoSpeaks: The organisation, for information and correction only
exposureNote: Engagement is public, permanent, searchable and quotable by strangers. Context collapse is fastest here and visible virality has been shown to increase outrage causally.
lengthBudget: Short, and written to survive being quoted out of context

avoidHere.why: Recognition works precisely because it supplies no culprit, and quote-posting is a machine for supplying one.
Emotional storytelling here exposes the teller to an audience that did not opt in.
Grief content cannot be protected from strangers on this surface.

evidenceNote: The strongest platform evidence in the corpus comes from here: the moral-communication findings on outrage, diffusion and conversion were computed on this platform's data. The finding is a warning about the platform, not a licence to use it well.
channelRule: Do not optimise for reach on this surface. Use it for information, correction and availability, and measure conversion rather than engagement.
